Both filters remain usable in archived projects, and completion summaries always count all tasks. Names are trimmed and required. Renaming preserves the URL, creation order, tasks, and completion summary. Archived projects disable renaming; restoration enables it again. Each task can also be renamed and assigned a Low, Normal, or High priority. Existing tasks default to Normal. Each project's Default task priority starts at Normal and can be set to Low, Normal, or High. New tasks inherit the saved default; changing it leaves existing tasks and both filters unchanged. Task edits immediately update matching rows without resetting any filter. Range controls remain usable while archived, and opening a project starts with empty boundaries. Each task row offers Destination project and Move task. Destinations list other active projects in project creation order. A first arrival appends the task after all positions established in its destination; returning restores its remembered position. Positions are remembered independently per project and survive restarts. Moving preserves its identity, title, completion, priority and due date, and keeps the source page and all filters open. Summaries reflect current ownership. Archived projects cannot send or receive tasks; move controls are disabled when archived or when no eligible destination exists.
